sentences.text: Weejasperaspis was an extinct acanthothoracid placoderm, a type of armored fish, discovered in the Wee Jasper reef in eastern New South Wales, Australia.
The type species, Weejasperaspis gavini, is distinguished by a short, triangular-shaped median dorsal crest and is known only from a dorsal plate and ossified eyeballs.
Taxonomically, the genus Weejasperaspis is classified within the family Weejasperaspidae.
This creature lived during the Early Devonian period, specifically between 410.62 and 393.47 million years ago in the Emsian stage.
